paragraphs: Mentioned in Sukkah 45b: Rabbi Yochanan reports in the name of Rabbi Shimon HaMachuzi, who reports in Rabbi Yochanan HaMakuti's name. Hyman infers that he was one of the last Tannaim.[^1][^2]

notes.text: The consulted Sukkah text has the report formula משום in this chain. The supplied notice instead prints כשם, interpreted in that reporting sense without changing its source text. The dating is Hyman’s inference.

The consulted Sukkah 45b explicitly writes the Rabbi Yochanan–Rabbi Shimon HaMachuzi–Rabbi Yochanan HaMakuti chain with משום. Hyman supplies כשם at the last link; that form remains unchanged in the Hebrew. The dating among the last Tannaim is Hyman’s inference from the transmission, not an independently established chronology.
